notes.title: 2.0.2 Beta
notes.notes:
- Added credits for russian translation and switch port
- Fixed some bugs that can happen when touch and controler input are used simultaneously
- Added a deadzone to analog sticks

notes.title: Controller support update
notes.notes:
- added controller support
- added russian subtitles
- fixed a few bugs
- improved performance overall

notes.title: Hot Fix
notes.notes: Removed the update screen at startup

notes.title: New features to be tested
notes.notes:
We've been working hard the past few months to improve performance, add new features and give players a new ending to the story.

We'd love to hear from you regarding any bugs before we release this on the production app.

Let us know of any issues by filing a ticket here https://zfrmz.eu/q8zSZCtyI3eknPSdnEf9

notes.title: Fixed some missing text in the epilogue scene
notes.notes: Some of Charlie's lines had disappeared with the previous update, they're back now.

notes.title: Hot Fix for blocking update issue
notes.notes: Fixed an issue with the game looking for an update

notes.title: UI bugfixes and Typos fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed disappearing UI Buttons
[*] Game now works in more extreme aspect ratios and resolutions
[*] Fixed many spelling and grammar errors in the FR dialogues
[*] Added some more sounds to the final scene
[/list]

notes.title: Solved Blocking bug and some visuals
notes.notes:
